attempts.response:
```sql
WITH giver_stats AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS receipt_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") OVER (PARTITION BY "Donor") > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_repeat_giver
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_vs_one_time AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_giver = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_giver_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_giver = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_giver_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_giver = 1 THEN "Amount" ELSE NULL END) AS repeat_giver_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_giver = 0 THEN "Amount" ELSE NULL END) AS one_time_giver_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "Donor",
            "Amount",
            is_repeat_giver
        FROM giver_stats
        JOIN donations USING ("Donor")
    )
)
SELECT
    NULLIF(repeat_giver_amount, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Amount") OVER (), 0) AS repeat_giver_share_percent,
    NULLIF(one_time_giver_amount, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Amount") OVER (), 0) AS one_time_giver_share_percent,
    repeat_giver_count AS repeat_giver_count,
    one_time_giver_count AS one_time_giver_count
FROM repeat_vs_one_time
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donations
) AS totals;
```
